2609.29044.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration of 3GPP Channel Estimators
2609.29044.paper_summary: Pilot-aided channel estimation is a decisive block in orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) receivers for both 5G New Radio (5G-NR) and Long-Term Evolution (LTE). A large body of estimators exists, from simple least-squares (LS) interpolation to statistically optimal linear minimum-mean-square-error (LMMSE) variants and, more recently, deep convolutional denoisers, yet no single estimator is uniformly best: the winner depends on the propagation scenario, the numerology, the operating signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the mobility (Doppler), and the antenna configuration. In this paper, we quantify this fact through a unified study of eight literature estimators evaluated over the 3GPP TR~38.901 Urban-Macro (UMa), Urban-Micro (UMi), and Rural-Macro (RMa) channels generated with NVIDIA Sionna, for both 5G-NR and LTE numerologies, in single-input single-output (SISO) and $8\times2$ multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) settings. We then propose a \emph{condition-adaptive multi-agent orchestrator} that treats each estimator as an independent agent and dispatches, per operating condition, to the agent that is best on a validation split without any genie knowledge. The orchestrator tracks the per-realization oracle to within $1.07$~dB and improves the normalized mean-square error (NMSE) over the best \emph{fixed} strategy by up to $3.6$~dB at high SNR, where the low-SNR champion is no longer optimal. Because the agents are independent, running them concurrently delivers this best-of-eight accuracy at essentially single-estimator latency: a data-parallel partition scales the wall-clock nearly as $1/K$ with $K$ workers (up to $6.9\times$), whereas naive by-algorithm partitioning is Amdahl-limited by the heaviest agent. The results substantiate multi-agent orchestration as a practical route to robust channel estimation across heterogeneous 5G-NR/LTE deployments.
2609.29044.paper_summary_zh: 試點輔助的通道估計是正交頻分多工（OFDM）接收器中的一個關鍵組件，適用於5G新無線（5G-NR）和長期演進（LTE）。存在大量的估計器，從簡單的最小二乘（LS）插值到統計最優的線性最小均方誤差（LMMSE）變體，以及最近的深度卷積去噪器，但沒有單一的估計器是均勻最佳的：勝者取決於傳播場景、數字設計、運行的信號噪聲比（SNR）、移動性（多普勒）和天線配置。在本文中，我們通過對八種文獻估計器的統一研究來量化這一事實，這些估計器在3GPP TR~38.901城市宏（UMa）、城市微（UMi）和農村宏（RMa）通道上進行評估，這些通道是使用NVIDIA Sionna生成的，適用於5G-NR和LTE數字設計，並在單輸入單輸出（SISO）和$8\times2$多輸入多輸出（MIMO）設置中進行。我們然後提出了一個\emph{條件自適應多代理協調器}，將每個估計器視為獨立的代理，並根據運行條件分派給在驗證拆分中表現最佳的代理，而不需要任何先驗知識。該協調器將每次實現的預言者追踪到$1.07$~dB內，並在高SNR下將標準化均方誤差（NMSE）相對於最佳\emph{固定}策略提高了最多$3.6$~dB，此時低SNR冠軍不再最優。由於這些代理是獨立的，並行運行它們在實際上以單一估計器的延遲提供了這種最佳八種準確性：數據並行分區幾乎以$1/K$的速度縮放時鐘時間，$K$工作者（最多$6.9\times$），而天真的按算法分區則受到最重代理的阿姆達爾限制。這些結果證實了多代理協調作為在異構5G-NR/LTE部署中進行穩健通道估計的實用途徑。
2609.29044.author: I. Zakir Ahmed et.al.
